summary: Suncor Energy filed a Form 6-K with Exhibit 99.1, a news release announcing a quarterly dividend of C$0.60 per share, payable September 25, 2026, to shareholders of record September 4, 2026. This is a routine current report of an ordinary dividend declaration, not a special situation. No strategic transaction, capital return program, or change of control is involved. The filing contains no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations beyond the dividend approval. As a non-US filer using Form 6-K, this maps to a routine US Form 8-K event, which falls outside special-situations classification.
